CNC turning
CNC turning for shafts & fittings

Turned shafts, fittings and flanges with internal and external features. Specify the fits, threads and concentricity your assembly needs.

Prepare RFQ email
Ring housings & angled components
Turned diameters and off-axis features

Cross-holes, flats or slots can require secondary machining. Their position relative to the turned features determines how the operations are combined.

Geometry & process
For shafts, sleeves, bushings and fittings built around a rotational axis. Stepped diameters, bores, grooves and threads can be combined in turned components. Live tooling adds cross-holes, flats, slots and milled details to cylindrical parts. Fitting services include NPT, BSPT and metric threads; state the thread standard, mating component and sealing requirements.
Size & workholding
Send the model, stock size, overall diameter and axial lengths. Identify the functional axis, shoulders, internal grooves and off-axis features so tool access and clamping space can be reviewed.
Material & finish
State the stock grade, condition and surface finish on the drawing. Identify sealing and sliding surfaces, mating-part requirements and the edges that need deburring.

Drawing & acceptance
Drawing requirements

Define the functional axis, bearing or sliding fits, shoulders and axial lengths. Identify any runout requirement relative to a named datum.

Give complete thread designations and engagement lengths. Mark internal grooves, cross-holes and flats that need access or deburring checks.

Inspection and acceptance

Give acceptance limits for the diameters and axial relationships that control assembly. A general precision requirement is insufficient to define these checks.

Agree thread gauging, edge condition and sealing-surface acceptance; a dimensional report alone does not establish leak performance.

Agree the measurement method and required records before production.

Quality & inspection
Equipment and order records
Prepare your cnc turning enquiry

Include mating-part information, stock grade and condition, surface finish and the quantity per release.

If you need functional testing or a report, specify the method and acceptance criteria to be agreed.

Prepare RFQ email

Add your requirements to the email draft, then attach drawings in your email app before sending.
